venira.avoid_when: you change a few lines (project_edit_file). overwrite is immediate and not undoable: project_snapshot first when the file is not in git.
venira.output_kind: action (created|overwritten|appended), bytes_written, sha256_after. mode=create on an existing path gives conflict.
venira.speed_profile: fast; clears the read/list/search cache for the affected path.

description:
Write a file. mode=create (fails if it exists), overwrite, or append. create_dirs=1 creates parent folders.
Use when: you create a file, replace one entirely, or append. expected_sha256 refuses the write if the file changed since you read it.
Avoid when: you change a few lines (project_edit_file). overwrite is immediate and not undoable: project_snapshot first when the file is not in git.
Output: action (created|overwritten|appended), bytes_written, sha256_after. mode=create on an existing path gives conflict.

expected_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file's current full content. The write is refused if the file on disk differs. Use sha256_after from your last write/edit of this file; read_file's sha256 only matches when the whole file was returned.

mode.description: Default overwrite: replaces existing contents; create and verify a scoped project_snapshot first. create fails if the path exists; append adds to the end.

reason.description: Optional why (max 400 chars), audit-logged. Required only on project_ci_control.

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative ('.' = root); absolute/.. outside it rejected.
